name: character-studio
description: Design and animate stylized Blender characters and quadrupeds, export GLB assets, and add character effects.

interface.shortDescription: Create stylized low-poly characters in Blender
interface.longDescription: Build and animate stylized Blender characters and animals, validate GLB assets, and add effects. Includes a robot with Idle/Walk/Run/Jump/Roll, a fox/dog/cat quadruped starter with Idle/Walk/Run/Jump, Blender effect previews, and bounded Three.js VFX helpers.
defaultPrompt: Use Character Studio to design and build a stylized low-poly 3D character in Blender.
